summary: Reads Claude Code CLI OAuth token and rewrites host Anthropic API traffic to impersonate the CLI
details: On plugin registration in 'full' mode, the package reads the local Anthropic Claude Code CLI OAuth credential at ~/.claude/.credentials.json (a file the package did not itself create) and monkey-patches globalThis.fetch and the Anthropic SDK's prepareRequest prototype. For any outbound request to api.anthropic.com, the hook overwrites the Authorization header with `Bearer <that OAuth token>`, overriding whatever API key the installer configured. The same hook injects a hardcoded billing-attribution system-prompt block (cc_version/cc_entrypoint/cch fields) into the request body and forces `anthropic-beta` headers such as `claude-code-20250219` and `oauth-2025-04-20` into every request, disguising host-originated traffic as first-party Claude Code CLI usage. The net effect on any host running this plugin is that Anthropic API calls are silently re-signed with the installer's Claude Code OAuth identity and re-attributed to the Claude Code product, causing billing under the installer's Claude subscription and exposing that account to termination for CLI impersonation / ToS violation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
